description: Governance application for accountable deployment, monitoring, reassessment, and remediation of algorithmic and automated decision systems.

algorithmic-system.label: Algorithmic system
algorithmic-system.description: A model, rules engine, scoring system, ranking system, or other automated decision capability subject to accountability controls.

deployment-context.label: Deployment context
deployment-context.description: A specific use of an algorithmic system for a defined purpose, population, organization, and decision process.

model-version.label: Model version
model-version.description: A materially identifiable version or release whose changes may trigger review, reassessment, or renewed authorization.
